scope: Public owner repos and public authored PR search. Excludes TechLuddite target owner case-insensitively. Deduplicated by canonical PR URL. Every upstream PR individually checked on source repository, and repository privacy checked before fetching PR detail. No issues or reviews included.
limitations: GitHub search can lag and is capped at 1000. No claim of all historical contributions. Metadata homepage links do not establish uptime. Prior snapshot featured a subset, so coverage growth does not establish new contributions.
